name: WF-C — AI Tech YouTube Daily Digest (8AM ET) [100% FREE]

nodes.name: Schedule: 8AM ET Daily
nodes.notes: 13:00 UTC = 9 AM EDT (summer) / 8 AM EST (winter). Timezone set to America/New_York in settings — handles DST automatically.

nodes.name: HTTP: YouTube Search API
nodes.notes: Get YouTube Data API v3 key FREE at: console.cloud.google.com → APIs → YouTube Data API v3. Free quota: 10,000 units/day. This search = 100 units.

nodes.name: HTTP: YouTube Video Details
nodes.notes: Fetches full stats (views, likes, comments) + full description + duration. Costs 1 unit per video. 10 videos = 10 units.

nodes.name: HTTP: Groq AI — Generate Digest

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  model: 'llama-3.3-70b-versatile',
  max_tokens: 4096,
  temperature: 0.7,
  messages: [
    {
      role: 'system',
      content: 'You are an expert AI technology analyst and newsletter editor. Your job is to analyze YouTube videos about artificial intelligence and technology, then create a concise, high-value daily digest for busy tech professionals, entrepreneurs, and AI enthusiasts. Write in a clear, direct, and engaging tone. Focus on: key insights, practical takeaways, and why it matters. You have deep knowledge of AI trends, LLMs, agents, tools, and the AI business landscape. Always return valid JSON only — no markdown, no explanation, just the JSON object.'
    },
    {
      role: 'user',
      content: 'Create a comprehensive AI Tech YouTube Digest for ' + $json.dateStr + '.

Today's Theme: ' + $json.label + '
Total Videos: ' + $json.count + '

' + $json.profiles.map((v, i) =>
        '── VIDEO ' + (i + 1) + ' ──
' +
        'Title: ' + v.title + '
' +
        'Channel: ' + v.channel + '
' +
        'Duration: ' + v.duration + ' | Views: ' + v.views + ' | Likes: ' + v.likes + '
' +
        'URL: ' + v.url + '
' +
        'Published: ' + v.publishedAt + '
' +
        'Tags: ' + v.tags + '
' +
        'Description:
' + v.description
      ).join('

') + '

Return ONLY valid JSON (no markdown, no code fences, no explanation) in this exact format:
{
  "digest_title": "AI Tech Digest — [date]",
  "theme": "' + $json.label + '",
  "headline_summary": "3-4 sentence executive summary of today's most important AI developments and trends",
  "top_pick": {
    "videoId": "most important video ID",
    "title": "video title",
    "channel": "channel name",
    "url": "https://youtube.com/watch?v=ID",
    "why_top_pick": "2-3 sentences: why this is today's must-watch and what makes it uniquely valuable"
  },
  "videos": [
    {
      "videoId": "id",
      "title": "title",
      "channel": "channel",
      "duration": "Xm Ys",
      "views": "Xk",
      "url": "url",
      "summary": "3-4 sentence summary: what the video covers, key arguments, and main value for the viewer",
      "key_takeaways": ["specific actionable takeaway 1", "specific takeaway 2", "specific takeaway 3"],
      "relevance_score": 8,
      "category": "Tutorial|News|Analysis|Demo|Interview|Review",
      "tags": ["AI", "tag2", "tag3"]
    }
  ],
  "todays_themes": ["major theme 1", "theme 2", "theme 3"],
  "tools_mentioned": ["tool or model name 1", "tool 2"],
  "key_companies": ["OpenAI", "company2"],
  "telegram_summary": "Short 3-4 line Telegram message with relevant emojis. Max 400 chars. Include video count and top highlight.",
  "one_liner": "One punchy sentence summarizing today's AI world in under 20 words"
}'
    }
  ]
}) }}

nodes.notes: FREE — Groq free tier: 14,400 req/day. Model: llama-3.3-70b-versatile (very capable). Get free key at: console.groq.com — no credit card needed.

nodes.notes: Gmail SMTP setup in n8n: Settings → Credentials → New → SMTP → Host: smtp.gmail.com, Port: 465, SSL: ON, User: your@gmail.com, Pass: Gmail App Password (not your real password). Get App Password: myaccount.google.com → Security → 2-Step Verification → App Passwords
